name: Alex Mercer
interview_responses: I am a backend engineer with 7 years of experience. I previously led the migration of a monolithic application to a microservices architecture using Python and Kubernetes, which reduced latency by 40%.
I strongly believe in relying on data rather than opinions. When I disagree with a colleague, I propose we write a quick prototype or look at metrics to decide the best path.
To design a scalable system, I would use an API gateway routing to stateless microservices. For caching, Redis is excellent, and for asynchronous event processing, I'd rely on Kafka.
